provider_limit.resetsAt: It resets at {{time}}. Continue then, or run it on another provider.
provider_limit.reset: It resets {{resetAt}}. Continue then, or run it on another provider.
provider_limit.noReset: Wait for the limit to reset, then continue, or run it on another provider.

why.environment: The change itself isn't the problem. The machine needs something first.
why.port_in_use: The change itself isn't the problem: something else held the port. Stop it, or have the project read PORT (each run gets its own), then run again.
why.tests_failed: The checks still fail after the corrections.
why.blocked: A limit or a decision stopped it. It didn't crash.
why.timeout: It reached its time limit before finishing.
why.tool_inactivity: It stopped using tools and replying for too long.
why.crash: The provider process or its connection died mid-run.
why.incomplete_tasks: Everything else is done. Continue finishes what is left with the browser and its tools; a check only a person can make can go to review instead.
why.spec_invalid: The plan or spec didn't pass OpenSpec, and planning couldn't repair it.
why.unknown: The run's own records don't name the cause. An AI reading of the log usually finds it.

environment.generic: The environment needs attention before the run can continue.
environment.then: When that is done, continue the run.

environmentPlan.offer: {{repository}} pins Python {{version}}, but its checks may run on a newer system Python. A Python {{version}} virtual environment makes them match the project.
environmentPlan.apply: Use a Python {{version}} venv for checks
environmentPlan.saved: Saved to the project settings. The next launch builds the venv before its checks.
environmentPlan.failed: Could not save the settings. Open Project settings to configure them.

analysis.title: AI analysis
analysis.offer: Ask the AI to read the log and explain why this run stopped.
analysis.running: Reading the log to find why it stopped…
analysis.by: AI analysis by {{model}}. It reads the log; check the lines it cites.
analysis.stale: The log changed since this analysis.
analysis.interrupted: The analysis was interrupted (the app restarted while it ran). Try again.

ai.label: From AI analysis
ai.running: Reading the log with AI to find the cause…

remedyResult.continued: Continuing to review with the remaining items as checks by hand.
remedyResult.notResumed: The continued run did not start

consequence.continue: Keeps everything and goes on from the step that failed.
consequence.continueTasks: Keeps everything and redoes only what was missing, with the browser and install guidance.
consequence.continueEnvironment: Keeps everything; the agent is told what is missing and installs it, then goes on.
consequence.continueLimit: Keeps everything and goes on once the provider accepts requests again.
consequence.continueTransient: Keeps everything and runs the same step again.
consequence.continueStopped: Picks it up where it stopped, in the same worktree, with everything it did so far.
consequence.continueToReview: Sends it to review now, with what is left listed as checks by hand.
consequence.editSpec: Opens the spec; a change to it starts a new run.
consequence.fixEnvironment: Shows what the machine needs and the command to run.
consequence.openLogs: Scrolls to the failed step in the log.
consequence.retry: A fresh run from the base. This attempt's work is not carried over; it stays in the old worktree.
consequence.analyze: The AI reads the log and says why it stopped.

stopped.headline: You stopped this run
stopped.whyNoContinue: Its work stays in its worktree. Start over runs it again from the base.

lineage.title: Attempts
lineage.explain: Each attempt continued the one before it, keeping its work. The latest one speaks for all of them.
lineage.continuedFromStep: continued from the {{step}} step of attempt {{attempt}}
lineage.byReview: Sent to review with checks by hand
